## `neuro.object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor`

Static method on `Object`.

> Gets the own property descriptor of the specified object.
> An own property descriptor is one that is defined directly on the object and is not inherited from the object's prototype.

## Signatures

```ts
getOwnPropertyDescriptor(input: { o: any; p: PropertyKey; prompt?: string }): Promise<PropertyDescriptor>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
